link_text_extension.addition_only: This key adds to AM-4 exactly the operations in permitted_operations, on exactly the 16 entries, at exactly the read_sites. AM-4's tier, scope and unknown_52_current_state are unchanged and not reinterpreted. Its raw materialization and identity-hashing scope is neither widened nor narrowed. Its A0 first observation of 52 compressed loose containers without decompression is neither widened nor narrowed.
link_text_extension.entry_location: Each path is relative to the relative_root of the config git_checkouts entry that has the same commit, under paths.source_home. validate() requires each checkout to declare exactly its eight entries, with mode 120000 and the listed oid. A config cannot add, omit, re-mode or re-blob an entry.
permitted_operations: lstat of every ancestor of the entry path; any symlink ancestor refuses.
Classification of the entry from its parent directory listing through an O_NOFOLLOW directory fd (d_type, or fstatat with AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW on DT_UNKNOWN). The walk never descends into the entry.
lstat of the entry before readlink. It must report S_ISLNK with st_size from 33 to 55 inclusive.
readlink of the entry, only at the read sites below.
A second lstat that must equal the first, with the text length equal to st_size.
Git blob SHA-1 over the ASCII bytes 'blob ', the decimal text length, one NUL byte and the text. The hash is used only as each read site states.
Lexical parsing of the text by link_target. This happens only at C1, and only after the SHA-1 equals the entry oid.

text_bytes.enforcement: Before readlink, lstat st_size must be within 33..55; otherwise the runner refuses without calling readlink. After readlink, a second lstat must equal the first and the text length must equal st_size. The SHA-1 then binds the exact bytes.
text_bytes.limit: The bound is a pre-read check, not a readlink buffer size. Suppose an entry were replaced between the first lstat and readlink. Only trusted same-uid host actors could do that: source_home is mounted read-only in C, E and F, and is writable in D only to the D worker. readlink could then return longer text into memory before the post-read check refuses. That text is never hashed, parsed or recorded.

read_sites.use: The SHA-1 must equal the entry oid before any parsing. Then link_target requires the text to name a declared regular row of the same checkout.

The value 'git-symlink:' plus the SHA-1 is recorded in C_RAW_IDENTITIES.json files, and membership must equal the authenticated set. The source does not compare this value with the entry oid directly; that is Review A optional hardening, not adopted. The value is tied to C1 only by the read-only C mount and the trusted same-uid boundary.

The whole map must equal C_RAW_IDENTITIES.json files before freeze, and it is recorded in D_FREEZE.json. D does not call frozen_source. D's following walk_tree only classifies the entry, and chmod_nofollow is never applied to it.
The whole map must equal D_FREEZE.json files.
The whole map must equal D_FREEZE.json files.
The whole map must equal D_FREEZE.json files.
The whole map must equal D_FREEZE.json files. output_check's target and OUT_DIR walks admit no symlink and never involve an entry.

link_text_extension.no_read_phases: A0, A and B make no runner access to any entry; B runs Cargo only. The supervisor process never reads an entry. This extension adds no B operation. It does not interpret whether AM-4's checkout/materialization wording covers creating these entries.
link_text_extension.tier_binding: C1, C2, D1, E1 and E2 run only under a Tier 1 user receipt whose amendments_sha256 equals this file's SHA-256. F1 and F2 run only in tier1-and-compile mode. They additionally require a Tier 2 user receipt that binds the same amendments_sha256 and that Tier 1 receipt. Both receipts must also bind the new Root admission and the new config_inputs. Earlier receipts, admissions and grants are insufficient, including any bound to the predecessor amendments, to the pre-pin source or to R5.
target_exclusion: The runner never opens, stats with follow, resolves, realpaths, hashes or reads any target through an entry, at any site or phase.
This extension authorizes no target payload read and no dereference.

A target that is itself a regular row of the same checkout is read only through its own path. That read falls under the unchanged AM-4 raw identity scope, and under AM-2/AM-3 only if the target is an include. This extension adds nothing to that.
Entries are never includes or expected generated files: validate() refuses either at or under an entry path. SDK payload suffix exclusions and approved_includes() are unchanged apart from the pin.
Directory, missing, chained, escaping and cross-checkout targets are decided lexically from authenticated tree rows, and each refuses.
forbidden: readlink of any path other than the 16 entries, or of an entry outside the listed read sites.
chmod, write, unlink, rename or replacement of an entry by the runner.
Any other symlink anywhere in source_home, target or OUT_DIR; the walks refuse it.
Mode coercion, regular-file acceptance, forced materialization, or any change to core.symlinks, Git config, Cargo argv/env or SDK pins.
Any SDK decode; any parameter, key, proof, SRS or cache operation; network access; or a new resource value.
link_text_extension.failure_and_retry: Every failed check raises a terminal refusal at the failing predicate, and no caller catches it and continues. A failed size bound prevents readlink. A failed SHA-1 comparison prevents parsing. After any refusal, no entry is read again. Post-marker refusals write TERMINAL_FAILURE.json where possible and keep ONE_SHOT_STARTED. They are never retried, resumed, repaired or coerced.
not_covered: Any process other than the runner. Cargo and its children get no authority to stat or read through an entry; whether they do so in B, E or F is an unresolved fact.
Obtaining or reading any link text before a granted run, including pre-marker metadata reading. That is a separate Root decision.
Any widening of AM-4's raw materialization, identity-hashing or A0 container scope, or of AM-1 to AM-3.
link_text_extension.required_before_any_read: All of the following are required: fresh independent review of this file and of the pin-instantiated runner; Root admission of that runner's SHA-256; a complete, externally anchored final config pinning both; operator provisioning and numeric decisions under their own process; and a new user Tier 1 receipt binding this file's SHA-256, plus a Tier 2 receipt for F1 and F2.

tier_2_dependency: Tier 1 all passes plus distinct explicit AM-1/2/3 grant and Root admission.
